# App Banton Studios

> Full-service software studio specialising in SaaS and web application development, UX research, and product design. One team takes your idea from research through to a shipped, working product.

App Banton Studios is a software product studio based in Port of Spain, Trinidad, serving English-speaking clients worldwide. We design and build web applications, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, and design systems for founders, startups, and businesses with real problems to solve.

We do not hand off to a third party. Design and engineering are owned by the same team — there is no gap between what gets designed and what gets built.

## Services

- **Web Application Development**: Custom SaaS platforms, dashboards, internal tools, and customer portals. Designed and built to production quality.
- **SaaS Product Development**: End-to-end product development from research and design through to a deployed, scalable product.
- **Mobile App Development**: iOS and Android applications. Native feel, cross-platform efficiency. From concept through to App Store listing.
- **UX Research & Product Design**: User interviews, journey mapping, wireframes, prototypes, and usability testing. We validate before we build so nothing ships broken.
- **Design Systems**: Component libraries, tokens, and documentation. The foundation that keeps your product consistent as it scales.
- **Retainer / Ongoing Product Partner**: Ongoing development and design partnership for teams that need a reliable studio on call.

## Process

1. Discovery — stakeholder interviews, competitor audit, user journey mapping
2. Design — wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, interactive prototypes validated with real users
3. Build — clean, accessible, production-grade code with a component system your team can extend
4. Launch + Support — we ship, monitor early behaviour, and stay on to fix what reality exposes

## Selected Work

- **Literead** (https://literead.co): AI reading coach for children. Voice-based comprehension conversations that adapt to each student — like a tutor, not a test.
- **ShadowGovTT** (https://shadowgovtt.com): Trinidad & Tobago government services redesigned for the people who use them. Citizen-first UX for existing forms, portals, and websites.
- **Skylark Villa** (https://theskylarkvilla.com): Luxury villa website on Trinidad's northern coast. Cinematic, conversion-led, built to attract the right guest.
- **Cobaderos**: (https://cobaderos.com): Monetization layer for revocable credentials under EUDI v2. Provides an auditable, issuer-facing signal of credential verification activity that supports commercial billing — without violating the Architecture Reference Framework's privacy prohibitions.

## Ideal Client

Founders and product leads at startups and growing businesses who know what they want to build, have the budget to do it properly, and need a single team that can own both design and engineering end-to-end.

## Pricing Philosophy

We are not the cheapest option. We guarantee real outcomes — not just deliverables handed over a wall. Engagements range from fixed-scope design projects to full-build retainers.
